senses.gloss: (b. h.) to drip, flow; to murmur, speak lowly, whisper.
units: Yeb. 97ᵃ (ref. to Cant. VII, 10) מה כומר … מיד דּוֹבֵב as the heated mass of grapes drips as soon as you apply your finger, כך … דּוֹבְבוֹת וכ׳ so do the lips of scholars in the grave murmur when their names are cited; Snh. 90ᵇ; Bekh. 31ᵇ (Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ bot. רוחשות, Ar. דובבות); a. e.—2) *to drop pitch.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:4:2">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>נכרי עובדן ודוֹבְבָן</he> a gentile may tan them (the leather bottles) and pitch them; [<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <he>זופתן</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>רובבן</he>; Bab.
